name: Entry Point Buffer with Back-to-Front Projection
definition: A technique to skip transparent data by determining the first intersection of each ray with the visible volume. It uses an entry point buffer storing depth values and block indices, populated by projecting non-transparent blocks back-to-front.
summary: Entry Point Buffer with Back-to-Front Projection initializes rays at volume surfaces using block-level culling, skipping transparent data unlike standard bounding box raymarching.
